payload.blocks: Acceptance criteria of the release-chain discussion (when a step counts as finished and the next is admitted). Nothing else.
payload.headline: Release sequence: does each step end when the plan is done on main, or only after an fgOS release ships it?

parts.cause: Read the supervision spec: a plan today ends at status done (landed on main). A release (stage + activate a new fgOS build) is a separate step, and releases are stopped right now because release checks fail (question q-cmio6uyrqz).

options.does: Next plan is admitted as soon as the previous plan is done. Releases are cut on their own rhythm.
options.gain: No new wait; the chain keeps moving while releases are stopped.
options.harm: A step can be 'finished' while the running fgOS still lacks it.
options.label: Done on main ends a step

options.cost: New plan state + release hook, est. 150-300 lines across supervision and release.
options.does: Next plan waits until a release containing the previous plan is activated.
options.gain: Every step is live in the installed fgOS before the next starts.
options.harm: Whole chain stops while releases are broken (now). Needs a new 'released' state on plans.
options.label: Release ends a step

parts.recommendation: Done on main ends a step: the chain must not stop on the release checks that are failing today; release cadence is a separate concern.

scope.allows: The shaper writes 'a step ends at plan done' into the discussion's acceptance criteria.
scope.forbids: Changing release tooling or cutting a release.

parts.what: Your order (backlog p-755psfxpmh) says plans are 'complete and released in this order'. The machinery must know when one step is over so the next plan is admitted.
